gate: H1b-1b-2 corrected c_gamma error normalization and Lemma 8.4 route decision
scope: A fail-closed decomposition of the additional proof needed after the peer-reviewed correction to the GGPY/Maynard c_gamma-normalized error. H1b-1b-2a proves the traced actual prime-local denominator inequalities and a canonical-W_i size bound, but actual application-specific excluded-modulus overheads remain open. This ledger does not recover C3_abs, certify the corrected r-fold Lemma 8.4 composition, close SIV-07, or compute X_cert.

status_vocabulary.PRINTED_EXACT_STRUCTURE: The source prints the exact algebraic structure, but it is not yet a numerical bound.
status_vocabulary.PARAMETERIZED_EXPLICIT: An exact propagation formula is proved once named positive numerical inputs are supplied.
status_vocabulary.RATE_MISSING: At least one multiplier, exponent constant, or finite range remains implicit.
status_vocabulary.SPECIALIZATION_REQUIRED: A result for a special sieve function has not been proved uniformly for Maynard's actual functions.
status_vocabulary.HARD_BLOCKER: No route can be promoted until all upstream bounds and a common range are numerical.
status_vocabulary.PRIMARY_EXPLICIT_BOUND_AVAILABLE: A primary source supplies the required finite inequality.
status_vocabulary.PROJECT_FINITE_COMPONENT_CLOSED_FOR_ACTU: The project proves this component for every traced actual application, not for the abstract g(p)=p+O(k) class.
status_vocabulary.PROJECT_PARAMETERIZED_EXPLICIT: A hidden asymptotic term has been replaced by a formula in named parameters, but the parent numerical package remains open.
status_vocabulary.BASE_W_PARAMETERIZED_APPLICATION_OVERHEA: The canonical W_i contribution is explicit, but augmented effective excluded moduli in actual calls are not yet all certified.
status_vocabulary.PARAMETERIZED_EXPLICIT_APPLICATION_INPUT: The analytic conversion is explicit once an application-specific excluded-modulus bound is supplied, but that input is not yet certified for every call.
status_vocabulary.PRIMARY_CANDIDATE_APPLICATION_AUDIT_OPEN: The explicit lower-bound route is the primary candidate, but it is not proved for every actual call until the excluded-modulus inventory is closed.
status_vocabulary.OPTIONAL_SECONDARY_ROUTE: This route remains an alternative comparison route and may become necessary if the primary candidate cannot be closed.

a finite truncation and tail error

obligations.role: lower-bound the convergent product over nonexcluded primes
obligations.printed_information: For every traced actual Section 8 call, the prime-local denominator is one of four exact families satisfying 0<g(p)<=p-a. Since nonexclusion gives n_j(p)<=a-1, every nonexcluded local factor is at least one.
